item.title: JHS Girls Wrestling 11th, Boys 13th At Al Larsen Invitational
item.description: CARRINGTON – Jamestown Blue Jay Girls Wrestling finished 11th of 29 teams and the Blue Jay boys were 13th of 19 teams at the Al Larsen Invitational, which was held Friday and Saturday at Carrington High School.

item.title: Blue Jays Boys Win Home Meet Over Dickinson, Mandan
item.description: JAMESTOWN – Jamestown Blue Jays Boys Swimming & Diving defeated Dickinson and Mandan Saturday in the Jamestown Relays at the Jamestown High School Pool. The Blue Jays had 550 points. Mandan scored 465 and Dickinson had 355.
